summary: Eight ordinal categorical data slots, --ui-data-cat-{1…8}-{solid,bg,fg}: the vivid palette from the Paper Charts page, curated in a light and a dark row (ADR 0008 amendment 2026-11-10). Every solid is a non-text pair on bg-base and bg-surface; adjacent slots are held to ΔE ≥ 15 normally and ≥ 6 under protan/deutan in every stress brand. The four named data roles are unchanged.
